snippet.title: PlayStation - Hyper Final Match Tennis (1996)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Join the on-court action with characters created using the latest motion capture technology, mixed in with genuine player and crowd sound samples. Travel the globe to New York, Tokyo, London, Paris and Melbourne in the international Grand Slam tournament and compete on lawn, clay and hard courts. With the help of 10 different camera perspectives and a choice of singles, doubles, mixed doubles, and simultaneous 1, 2, 3 and 4-player modes, this is the most accurate tennis sim you can buy.
